command:
set -euo pipefail
range=d33c62eebc48de5e8a65c50e057addf25f125c6b..51e7faddad943ab7727e407d008e474ec076566d
printf "added_guard_lines_by_production_file_top30\n"
git diff --unified=0 "$range" -- "src/**/*.cpp" "src/**/*.cppm" "src/**/*.hpp" "src/**/*.h" |
awk '
/^\+\+\+ b\// { file=substr($0,7); next }
/^\+[^+]/ {
  line=substr($0,2)
  if (line ~ /(^|[[:space:]])if[[:space:]]*\(/ &&
      line ~ /(!|nullptr|empty\(|IsValid|Invalid|Has[A-Z]|IsOperational|IsFinite|Error)/) print file
}
' | sort | uniq -c | sort -nr | sed -n "1,30p"
printf "representative_added_guard_lines\n"
git diff --unified=1 "$range" -- "src/**/*.cpp" "src/**/*.cppm" |
awk '
/^\+\+\+ b\// { file=substr($0,7); next }
/^\+[^+]/ {
  line=substr($0,2)
  if (line ~ /(^|[[:space:]])if[[:space:]]*\(/ &&
      line ~ /(!|nullptr|empty\(|IsValid|Invalid|Has[A-Z]|IsOperational|IsFinite|Error)/) print file "\t" line
}
' | sed -n "1,220p"
